name: Marden Henge
summary: Marden Henge is the largest Neolithic henge enclosure discovered to date in the United Kingdom. The monument is north-east of the village of Marden, Wiltshire, within the Vale of Pewsey and between the World Heritage Sites of Avebury and Stonehenge.
aka: The Hatfield Earthwork: a henge enclosure, henge and remains of monumental mound at Marden
